adapter.description: Source templates and a project-scoped Pi subagent extension for the small-project workflow.

STRONG_MODEL.description: An installed Pi model selector in provider/model-id form for decisions, review, and test planning.

STRONG_THINKING.description: A thinking level accepted by the selected strong Pi model.

EXECUTION_MODEL.description: An installed Pi model selector in provider/model-id form for bounded execution and reporting.

EXECUTION_THINKING.description: A thinking level accepted by the selected execution Pi model.

rules: Replace every required token before writing an output file.
Reject empty values and unresolved {{...}} tokens.
Do not substitute a different provider, model, or thinking level when a configured capability is unavailable.

skill_package.reason: The installed workflow must retain its authoritative SPEC.md at the workflow skill's references location and preserve the complete sibling skill package.

tool.name: small_project_subagent
tool.model_policy: The extension validates the configured provider/model against Pi's model registry before spawning. It never falls back.

validation: Each rendered agent has name, description, tools, model, and thinking frontmatter.
The prompt, not a subagent definition, acts as the main-session orchestrator.
The extension discovers only .pi/agents in the current project hierarchy.
The extension invokes a separate Pi process with JSON, no-session, approval, model, thinking, tools, and appended system-prompt flags.
